column1: Add a new AI Use Case to the global catalog
column3: Super Admin (global); Organization Admin / Change Manager (org/project-scoped custom use cases, subject to approval)
column4: Platform-wide (Super Admin, global catalog) or Organization/Project-scoped (custom use cases via D15c)
column5: Global catalog entries remain Super-Admin-only per the base spec. This design adds a self-service 'Custom AI Use Case' capability (D15c) so an Organization Admin or delegated Change Manager can author an org/project-scoped use case, subject to an approval workflow before it goes live.
column6: Extension beyond Functional Spec §Module 17 (base spec was Super-Admin-only) — see D15c for full data model
column7: New capability — requires a create/approve/publish workflow in Module 17's UI; approval gate should reuse the same human-in-the-loop philosophy (CTRL-006) applied to review before activation, not just before AI output.

column1: Customize an AI use case's underlying prompt / instructions
column3: Super Admin (edit seeded-use-case default templates); Organization Admin / Change Manager (org/project-scoped overrides, subject to approval)
column4: Global default template (Super Admin) with Organization- or Project-scoped override versions (D15d)
column5: This design adds a Prompt Template Registry (D15d): every AI Use Case — seeded or custom — has a versioned prompt template. Organizations can create a scoped override version without touching the global default; overrides go through the same approval gate as new use cases.
column6: Extension beyond Functional Spec §Module 17 (base spec described only model/provider selection, not prompt content) — see D15d for full data model
column7: New capability — needs a version-control and rollback mechanism (Superseded_By_Version) and a way to diff an override against the global default before publishing.

column1: Choose a real LLM provider / model per Organization
column3: Any user with access to the Provider Connection panel (implied Organization-scoped)
column4: Per Organization / per signed-in user's browser
column5: Provider Connection panel: pick Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, supply API key, choose model from curated shortlist
column6: Functional Spec §Module 17 Real LLM Provider Connection
column7: API key stored in browser local storage only, never journi backend (no backend exists) — see CTRL-016. Falls back to built-in generator on any call failure (CTRL-017).
